To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) cDNA microarray technology can be used to identify novel molecular targets in bladder cancer; (2) bladder cancer cell lines can be classified into distinct biological clusters based on their expression profiles; (3) cell adhesion molecules are important targets in urothelial carcinomas and may be used as prognostic markers; and (4) the combined expression of caveolin-1 and keratin 10 can be used to distinguish squamous differentiation in primary tumors.
